name: Vinpocetine
aliases: (+)-cis-Apovincaminic acid ethyl ester, Cavinton, Ethyl apovincaminate, RGH 4405, (+)-Apovincaminic acid ethyl ester, Apovincaminic acid ethyl ester, AY 27255, Bravinton
summary: Vinpocetine (ethyl apovincaminate), sold under the brand name Cavinton among others, is a synthetic derivative of the vinca alkaloid vincamine, differing by the removal of a hydroxyl group and by being the ethyl rather than the methyl ester of the underlying carboxylic acid. Vincamine is extracted from either the seeds of Voacanga africana or the leaves of Vinca minor (lesser periwinkle).

pharmacology.text: Vinpocetine's mechanism of action has been postulated to involve three potential effects: blockage of sodium channels, reduction of cellular calcium influx, and antioxidant activity.

uses.text: Vinpocetine has been used in many Asian and European countries for treatment of cerebrovascular disorders such as stroke and dementia for over three decades. The FDA has tentatively ruled that vinpocetine, due to its synthetic nature and proposed therapeutic uses, is ineligible to be marketed as dietary supplement under the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.

sideEffects.text: Use during pregnancy may harm the baby or result in miscarriage. Adverse effects of vinpocetine include flushing, nausea, dizziness, dry mouth, transient hypo- and hyper-tension, headaches, heartburn, and decreased blood pressure. FDA issued a statement in 2019 warning that "vinpocetine may cause a miscarriage or harm fetal development".

summaryZh: 長春西汀，中文化學名為乙基阿朴長春胺-22-醋酸乙酯，商品名開文通（英語：Cavinton）等，是一種吲哚類有機化合物，化學式為C22H26N2O2，屬於長春花生物鹼，存在於小蔓長春花（學名：Vinca minor）的葉中。
summaryZhHans: 长春西汀，中文化学名为乙基阿朴长春胺-22-醋酸乙酯，商品名开文通（英语：Cavinton）等，是一种吲哚类有机化合物，化学式为C22H26N2O2，属于长春花生物碱，存在于小蔓长春花（学名：Vinca minor）的叶中。
